what_happened: On an open highway with no lead within 50 m, the ego braked for no clear reason (15.7 → 9.2 m/s) and fell about 14 m behind the recorded drive. At the same time it drifted left about 1 m toward the lane line, and its front-left corner clipped actor 1 as that car passed in the adjacent left lane. A trailing car then hit the ego's rear, but only after the front collision.
